description: Source code for Azure Foundry (Azure AI) Agents API integration, including configuration, request transformation, environment validation, and completion dispatching with support for async and sync operations.

classes.name: AzureAIAgentsError
classes.description: Exception class for Azure AI Agent Service API errors.

classes.name: AzureAIAgentsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure AI Agent Service API, handling request transformation, environment validation, and completion dispatching.

methods.name: is_azure_ai_agents_route
methods.description: Checks if a model string corresponds to an Azure AI Agents route.

methods.name: get_agent_id_from_model
methods.description: Extracts agent ID from model string.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Retrieves API base URL and key, possibly from environment variables.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns minimal supported OpenAI parameters for Azure Agents.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Azure Agents parameters.

methods.name: _get_api_version
methods.description: Retrieves API version from optional parameters or defaults.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for Azure AI Agent Service.

methods.name: _get_agent_id
methods.description: Determines agent ID from model string or optional parameters.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms messages into request payload for Azure Agents.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares headers with authentication for Azure Foundry Agents.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns appropriate exception class for errors.

methods.name: should_fake_stream
methods.description: Indicates that streaming is faked via polling.

methods.name: supports_stream_param_in_request_body
methods.description: Indicates no stream param in request body.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Transforms raw response into ModelResponse (not used here).

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Dispatches completion request, supporting sync, async, and streaming via Azure AD tokens.
